The '''Sisar Run''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace trade route]] that originated in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]], passed through the heart of the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]] into [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], then continuing past [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] and bypassing the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]] before splitting by [[Sespe system/Legends|Sespe]].

A minor arm of the run was the [[Ac'fren Spur]] which stretched from Sriluur to [[Ques/Legends|Ques]]. From Ques one could reach [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]] and [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] in the Si'Klaata Cluster. Another branch of the Sisar Run was the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]].

[[Human/Legends|Humans]] among populations that had long lived in the area of the Sisar Run commonly had [[Color/Legends|light brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the majority of the Sisar Run was under the control of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Sprax]], which did not sit well with another Vigo, [[Durga Besadii Tai]].

In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Embra]] was the head of the anti-[[Yuuzhan Vong]] resistance called the [[Sisar Runners]].
